lost.source: plaintext JOB SUMMARY Supports the organization’s digital strategy and business operations by designing, developing, enhancing, and maintaining secure, scalable web and mobile applications that improve the experience of members and employees. This role builds and supports internal and external digital platforms—including public websites, intranet, extranet, and digital banking applications—using Optimizely CMS/Commerce (DXP) and Microsoft technologies such as C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, WCF, Razor, and ADO.NET, along with modern front-end frameworks including JavaScript, ReactJS, jQuery, Bootstrap, HTML, and CSS. Working in an Agile environment, the position collaborates with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, participate in architecture and design discussions, develop reusable components and APIs, integrate backend systems and databases (SQL Server and Oracle), and ensure applications meet performance, security, and quality standards. Key Responsibilities .NET Application Development: Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade websites and applications using Microsoft technologies including C#, .NET Core, and ASP.NET MVC, with preferred experience in Optimizely CMS/Commerce and Digital Experience Platform (DXP). Build and support enterprise applications using n-tier architecture and established design patterns within the Microsoft technology stack. Front-End Development & User Experience: Develop responsive and accessible user interfaces using JavaScript, jQuery, JSON, ReactJS, Bootstrap, HTML5, and CSS3. Collaborate with UX designers and stakeholders to deliver intuitive digital experiences. Utilize design and prototyping tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite to support UI/UX design validation, usability testing, and iterative design improvements. API Development & Systems Integration: Design and implement SOAP and RESTful APIs using Microsoft technologies including WCF and ASP.NET Web API. Integrate applications with backend systems and services using .NET, OLE DB, and other enterprise data access technologies. Ensure secure, scalable, and reliable system integrations across internal and external platforms. Database Development & Data Modeling: Collaborate with database developers to support data modeling, schema design, and performance optimization. Contribute to database development tasks using Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle as required. Agile Development & Cross-Team Collaboration: Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives. Manage development activities using Team Foundation Server (TFS), Azure DevOps, or other enterprise project management tools. Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Marketing and IT— including Project Management, Business Analysts, QA, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Database Administration—as well as onsite and offshore resources to ensure successful solution delivery, alignment with business objectives, and ongoing operational support. Testing, Optimization & Development Standards: Perform unit testing, debugging, performance tuning, and code refactoring to ensure high-quality and maintainable software. Adhere to organizational coding standards, documentation requirements, and secure development practices. Maintain accurate task tracking, code changes, and version control using Git or other enterprise source control systems. Platform Support & Website Maintenance: Support and enhance internal and external digital platforms, including intranet, extranet, public websites, and digital banking applications. Ensure applications meet availability, reliability, and performance standards in accordance with service level agreements (SLAs). Provide troubleshooting and technical support for application-related issues and user requests. Serve as backup administrator for Windows-based web servers when required. Security, Compliance & Documentation: Ensure compliance with organizational policies related to data protection, cybersecurity, network security, and antivirus standards. Maintain accurate service records, system documentation, configuration documentation, and knowledge base articles. Contribute to operational documentation and system runbooks supporting application environments. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Computer Science Knowledge of financial/banking industry 3+ years of software development experience on the Microsoft technology stack. 3+ years of backend development experience using C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Razor, and ADO.NET. 3+ years of front-end development experience building responsive and interactive user interfaces using JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, JSON, HTML5, CSS3, and Bootstrap (or similar frameworks). Experience designing and implementing user-centric web applications, with a strong focus on usability and overall UI/UX experience. 3+ years of database development experience using T-SQL with Microsoft SQL Server. 2+ years of experience developing and consuming web services and APIs, including REST and/or SOAP using Web API or WCF. Preferred Qualifications Experience illustrating design concepts through storyboards, workflow diagrams, wireframes, and UI mockup Experience implementing complex business workflows and enterprise application logic. Knowledge of secure application development practices, including implementing security controls in .NET applications and web servers. Familiarity with modern front-end development tools Experience developing solutions using Optimizely CMS/Commerce or Digital Experience Platform (DXP). Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks such as React, Angular, or similar libraries.

We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.       Job Title: Software Engineer - II/ .Net Developer   Location:  Atlanta, GA 30326 or Oklahoma City, OK 73132, or Cincinnati, OH 45249 – 3 days onsite   Duration:  9 months assignment with the possibility of extension   Job Description:    Client, a leader in payment technology, is seeking an experienced  Software Engineer II  to join our Paymetric Engineering team. In this role, you will be a key contributor to the development of highly transactional, cloud-based microservices and solutions, with a strong emphasis on tokenization and encryption for the payments/fintech industry.   This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, agile environment and enjoys collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.   Responsibilities:     Design, develop, and maintain backend services using .NET and .NET Core, with a focus on high-transaction payment platforms.   Build and optimize cloud-based microservices in AWS, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security.   Work closely with engineering leads and managers to articulate and implement solutions for complex problems, including the ability to write and explain pseudocode.   Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the software development lifecycle using Agile methodologies.   Contribute to the ongoing improvement of engineering processes and best practices within the team.   Participate in code reviews and collaborate with team members to deliver robust, maintainable software solutions.     Required Qualifications:     3-5 years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years in FINTECH or payments platforms.   Proficiency in .NET and .NET Core.   Experience with cloud development, especially AWS and AWS databases.   Strong backend development experience in high-transaction environments (front-end/UI experience is not required).   Demonstrated ability to write and troubleshoot code, including the ability to explain solution approaches and pseudocode clearly.     Preferred Qualifications:     Experience with microservices architecture.   Familiarity with Docker and containerization.   Working knowledge of both SQL and NoSQL databases.   Experience with Git for version control.   Exposure to Kubernetes orchestration.   Knowledge of C/C++ (a plus).   Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, TeamCity).     Selection Process:     Coding Assessment:  Candidates will be required to complete a Hackerrank test.   Interview Rounds:     Interview with the manager   Technical interview with Software Engineering leads   Final round interview with QA and Scrum Master             Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Python development, Generative AI, Agentic AI frameworks, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and cloud-native application development.    This role involves building intelligent AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, tool usage, memory management, and multi-agent collaboration to automate complex business processes and enhance enterprise productivity.    Key Responsibilities    Design and develop AI-powered applications using Python and modern AI frameworks.  Build autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or OpenAI Agents SDK. unrecognized: CISSP / OSCP / GPEN / GWAPT / GXPN / GSE

lost.source: Differentiating Behaviors Skilled in leading complex technical projects with expertise in cybersecurity, software engineering, agile methods, and customer interaction. Proficient in evaluating the relative costs, benefits, and trade-offs of potential courses of action to pinpoint the optimal solution. Skilled in task organization, time management, and prioritization to align actions with business objectives. Meticulous attention to detail, adept at articulating crucial specifics clearly in both verbal discourse and technical documentation. Proficient in cultivating cooperative, transparent working partnerships with technology teams and various stakeholders, including vendor relationships. Skilled at translating complex technical findings and risk assessments into clear, concise narratives tailored to executive, legal, or non-technical stakeholders. Effective communication skills, capable of conveying information clearly and engaging with technical and non-technical audiences across various levels. Information Security certifications such as CEH, CISM, CISA, Security+, Network+, CISSP, OSCP, GPEN, GWAPT, GXPN, and GSE are a plus, but not required. Demonstrated ability to drive end-to-end automation and workflow solutions for data security, from idea and design through implementation and continuous improvement. Experience leveraging PowerShell scripting to automate repetitive security tasks, generate operational reports, and integrate with enterprise security tooling. Proven experience leading or contributing to multiple concurrent security or data protection projects, balancing hands-on technical work with stakeholder alignment and risk-based prioritization.

Strong programming skills in Python and JavaScript, with solid experience in at least one of: Java, PowerShell, or C#; comfortable switching across languages and technology stacks to contribute to multiple active projects simultaneously. Hands-on experience developing automation and security workflows, dedicating a significant portion of time to building software and integrations for data protection initiatives. Strong experience with Endpoint. Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python and PowerShell for task automation, system administration, security operations workflows, and integration with enterprise platforms (e.g., Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Azure). Manage DLP tools, including configuring policies, tuning, testing, and implementing new features and functionality. Provide support across multiple areas of data security and operations: Data Loss Prevention (DLP), data minimization, data discovery, cloud data protection, Privileged Access Management (PAM), data privacy, data labeling, data classification and rights management, data encryption, and data access governance. Manage the technical configuration, implementation, administration, and support of multiple data security products and solutions such as CASB, SASE, DLP, and DSPM. Develop technical documentation (e.g., system designs, architecture diagrams, data flows, functional specifications). Leverage APIs to collect key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) for data governance and protection controls. Collaborate with senior leadership and cross-functional teams including Security Operations, Legal, Privacy, Data and Analytics, Enterprise Architecture, Platform teams, and sector functions. Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) to deploy and operate security and data protection solutions. Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git), CI/CD pipelines, and automation tools to accelerate delivery and maintenance of security capabilities. Experience using data analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Looker, QuickSight) to create dashboards and insights for KPIs and KRIs related to data security. Ability to analyze security telemetry and operational data to generate actionable insights that drive program decisions and risk mitigation strategies. Solid background and understanding of security concepts such as data classification, data loss prevention (DLP) strategies , data discovery, data masking, rights management, data residency, cloud data protection, and regulatory compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, PCI-DSS). 3+ years in data security, data loss prevention (DLP), software development, or computer engineering; or master's degree in computer science/engineering or related data security field, and 1 year of relevant experience.

lost.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.      Job Title:  Full Stack Developer   Location(s):  San Francisco, CA.         Job Description:     Provides strategic direction and executes on infrastructure, security, continuous integration, deployment, and IT operations practices, scaling and metrics.   Runs day-to-day operations of production and development infrastructure for a cloud-based commerce platform.   Develops an innovative approach to simplify and streamline processes to increase system scalability and reliability, improve efficiency, and minimize errors.   Works with the Development and QA teams to provide continuous improvement of existing features and rollout of new services, ensuring high availability of our platform.     Expertise:     Java, Spring boot, Azure, CDP AKS, Kafka, MogoDB, AI(Copilot, Codex, Claude).     Skill Set:     Strong in Linux and Windows. Experience supporting web applications (Ruby and Java based preferred).   Scripting (Ruby, Perl, Python, Bash, Awk, PHP). Elastic Cloud / Virtualization (ESXi ,EC2, Rackspace Cloud, Hypervisor, KVM, Xen, VDI).   Build Automation (Jenkins, Hudson, Cruisecontrol, Electric Commander).   Systems automation and provisioning frameworks (Chef, Puppet, Cfengine, Babushka, Knife, Mcollective, Func, Kickstart, PXE). Large Scale Databases (MySQL, Oracle, MongoDB, HBase, Cassandra, Hadoop).   Test Driven Development (junit/phpunit/RSpec/Cucumber). Middleware (MQ).   Caching strategy (CDN, Varnish, memcached, Redis).   Familiar with high availability strategies (haproxy, Global Traffic Management / Multiple Datacenters, Geo DNS, failable architecture).   Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) support. Monitoring systems and frameworks (Nagios, Ganglia, CollectD, Graphite). Performance testing and analysis.   Package management workflows (Aptitude/dpkg, Yum/RPM). Single Sign On Technologies (LDAP, Kerberos, Open Directory, PAM).   Common Unix Systems Services (NFS, NTP, Apache, nginx). Security frameworks (IP Tables, Nessus, nmap). F5 BIG-IP, Vipirion.   Able to work in an Agile environment. Critical thinker with a research-oriented problem solving approach. REST API’s using XML and JSON. IBM 4690 OS.   Familiar with high availability strategies (haproxy, Global Traffic Management / Multiple Datacenters, Geo DNS, failable architecture), AI Technologies/Tools in Development framework.              Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

lost.source: Job Summary The Data Scientist will analyze large, complex operational datasets to develop statistical insights, machine learning solutions, and executive-ready dashboards that support business and product decisions. The role requires strong proficiency in Python, SQL Server, Oracle, Tableau, Splunk, statistical inference, and machine learning fundamentals. The candidate will translate ambiguous business requirements into actionable data problems, build production-quality data pipelines and dashboards, monitor deployed solutions for performance issues and data drift, and communicate findings effectively to Product Owners, VPs, and other stakeholders. Key Responsibilities •    Analyze large and complex operational datasets using Python, SQL, and statistical methods to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights. •    Develop data analysis and machine learning solutions using Python libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, and at least one of statsmodels, TensorFlow, or PyTorch. •    Apply statistical inference and hypothesis testing to investigate business and operational questions. •    Develop and evaluate machine learning models for classification, regression, clustering, and tree-based modeling. •    Query and analyze data from SQL Server and Oracle databases, with exposure to Snowflake where applicable. •    Build, optimize, and maintain Tableau dashboards that are user-friendly, performant, and suitable for executive audiences. •    Develop Splunk SPL searches and dashboards using operational data. •    Build and maintain production-quality data pipelines, dashboards, and reusable code rather than one-off scripts. •    Use Git/GitLab for version control and maintain well-documented, maintainable code. •    Monitor deployed pipelines, dashboards, and models to identify data drift, performance issues, and operational problems. •    Translate ambiguous business requests into clearly defined, actionable data problems and deliver practical solutions independently. •    Present findings, recommendations, and technical insights to non-technical stakeholders, Product Owners, and VP-level audiences. Required Qualifications •    Strong proficiency in Python, including pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn, plus experience with at least one of statsmodels, TensorFlow, or PyTorch. •    Experience working with SQL Server and Oracle; Snowflake experience is an advantage. •    Experience developing and optimizing Tableau dashboards for usability, performance, and executive reporting. •    Experience with Splunk SPL searches and dashboard development using operational data. •    Strong understanding of statistical inference and hypothesis testing on large, complex operational datasets. •    Knowledge of machine learning fundamentals, including classification, regression, clustering, and tree-based models. •    Experience with Git/GitLab version control and writing maintainable, documented code. •    Strong communication skills and the ability to present findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership. •    Ability to work independently, clarify ambiguous business requirements, and deliver production-quality data solutions. Preferred Qualifications •    Experience in telecommunications, cable, or call center operations. •    Knowledge of natural language processing (NLP), including transformers, Hugging Face, topic modeling, embeddings, or semantic search. •    Experience with MLOps tools and practices, including Prefect, Airflow, Docker, or GitLab CI/CD. •    Experience with time-series analysis involving high-volume event data. •    Familiarity with vector databases such as ChromaDB, Pinecone, or FAISS. •    Experience with Alteryx, including migration of workflows to Python, or tools such as Streamlit. •    Experience with REST APIs for platforms such as Jira, Tableau, or Splunk. •    Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Google Cloud Storage (GCS), AWS, or Azure. •    Experience with Snowflake.

You know when to build and when to reach for a managed AWS service you can justify that trade-off based on the problem.  You think in systems and evaluate designs critically whether reviewing AI-generated code or your own architecture catching the subtle bug, security gap, or design choice that won't hold up under load or misuse.  You use spec-driven development with AI as your default way of engineering software.  You treat performance as a design constraint, not a tuning pass after the fact.  You pick up new tools and approaches quickly, since the effective way to work with AI changes often, and you'd rather adapt early than fall behind.  You are decisive without being divisive you can analytically weigh trade-offs, balance competing priorities, and drive decisions that span organizational boundaries.  You have excellent communication and organization skills.      Minimum Qualifications:  BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or demonstrated equivalent experience.  Demonstrated fluency in leveraging AI technologies across the entire software development lifecycle, including breaking down user stories into actionable tasks, AI-assisted coding and  testing, automated defect resolution, and deployment of fully tested software.  Deep, hands-on experience building and deploying production systems on AWS (e.g., EC2, Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS/DynamoDB, API Gateway), with a record of real, customer-facing applications running in production.  Server-side software development experience with Python, Java, NodeJS, and/or other similar technologies; client-side web application development experience using React, Backbone, native JavaScript, and/or other comparable technologies.  Expertise in building secure, large-scale systems using fault-tolerant technologies (such as Elasticsearch, CockroachDB, Oracle, MongoDB & Kafka).  AWS certification (e.g., Solutions Architect, Developer) and/or CISSP/CCSP or similar security certification useful, not required.        Company Benefits & Culture  Opportunity to work with a dynamic team in a fast-paced environment  Exposure to cutting-edge technologies and methodologies  Supportive and collaborative work culture      Appreciate your quick response and please feel free to reach me out for any query you may have.      Thanks

lost.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.    Project Overview   We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer for a consulting role to support ongoing and future projects. The consultant will be instrumental in developing and maintaining sophisticated applications using .NET Core and Python for backend development, and React or NextJS for frontend development. This role requires significant expertise in deploying applications to Azure App Services, managing code repositories via DevOps or GitHub, and utilizing Azure managed identities for secure resource access. Additionally, the candidate should have comprehensive knowledge of Azure AD and Azure B2C authentication.   Job Functions & Responsibilities     Develop, test, and maintain high-quality web applications using .NET Core and Python.   Design and implement responsive and dynamic user interfaces using React or NextJS.   Implement RESTful APIs and integrate with third-party services.   Collaborate closely with our teams and stakeholders to gather requirements, provide technical insights, and translate them into detailed technical specifications.   Utilize DevOps or GitHub for efficient version control, continuous integration, and continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes.   Deploy and manage applications on Azure App Services, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and reliability.   Implement and manage Azure managed identities to ensure secure access to resources.   Integrate Azure AD and Azure B2C authentication into applications to manage user identities and access securely.   Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex application issues to maintain high performance and responsiveness.   Conduct thorough code reviews to uphold code quality standards and foster knowledge-sharing within the team.   Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously enhance development practices.   Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior developers, fostering a collaborative and innovative team environment.   Adapt to various projects and client needs, demonstrating flexibility and expertise in consulting engagements.   Communicate effectively with clients to understand their requirements and deliver solutions that meet their business objectives.     Skills     Extensive experience in backend development using .NET Core and Python.   Advanced proficiency in frontend technologies such as React or NextJS.   Strong knowledge of RESTful API development and integration with third-party services.   Familiarity with SQL Server or other relational databases and ORM frameworks.   Deep understanding of version control systems and CI/CD pipelines, specifically using DevOps or GitHub.   Expertise in deploying and managing applications on Azure App Services.   Strong knowledge of Azure managed identities for secure and efficient resource access.   Comprehensive knowledge of Azure AD and Azure B2C authentication for managing user identities and access securely.   Exceptional problem-solving skills with a demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues.   Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.   Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.   Ability to adapt to different projects and client needs, demonstrating flexibility and expertise in consulting engagements.   Commitment to continuous learning and staying updated with the latest technological advancements.     Education & Certifications     Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is required.   Professional certifications in .NET, Python, React, Azure, or DevOps are highly desirable.   Additional certifications or specialized training in cloud computing, particularly Azure, will be considered an advantage.     Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

lost.source: Job Description:	 Ansible Playbooks & Roles: Writing idempotent playbooks, structuring roles for reusability, managing dependencies. YAML & Jinja2: Deep understanding of YAML syntax, Jinja2 templating, filters, and conditionals for dynamic configuration. Inventory Management: Building dynamic and static inventories, grouping, host variables, and integration with external sources Linux Administration: Strong proficiency with common distributions (RHEL, Ubuntu, Debian, Alpine), package management, systemd, networking config, and security hardening. Windows Support: Ansible Windows modules, PowerShell remediation, and Active Directory integration (if applicable). Infrastructure Abstraction: Combining Ansible with Terraform or CloudFormation for hybrid approaches or using Ansible alone for configuration post-provisioning. Container & Kubernetes: Ansible for cluster bootstrapping, pod/ deployment management, and container runtime configuration. Version Control: Git workflows for playbook/role repositories, branching strategies, and pull-request-based reviews. CI/CD Integration: Embedding Ansible runs in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure Pipelines for automated testing, linting (ansible-lint), and deployment. Testing & Validation: Using Molecule for role testing, TestInfra for server validation, and integration with schema/ policy checks. lost.source: Please see job description attached!  *** is looking for an AI Engineer to design, build and run the agents that automate work across our digital commerce and transformation programs. The role is hands-on and product-minded: you take a business workflow, decide where an agent genuinely helps, and deliver a governed agent that people use every day. The work is built primarily on Client's AI platform, spanning Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Client Copilot Studio and the Client 365 and Teams surfaces where our teams already work.   This is a production engineering role rather than a prototyping one. Agents you build are expected to clear the *** Agentic Framework bar before they reach users: registered in the Agent Registry, authenticated through Client Entra, authorized under least-privilege RBAC, instrumented for observability, and certified through evaluation testing. You own that path end to end, from the first system prompt and tool schema through deployment, monitoring and iteration.   You will work alongside program managers, data engineers, BI developers, solution architects and security partners, and you will spend as much time defining what good looks like as writing code. Strong candidates are comfortable with ambiguity, opinionated about evaluation, and able to explain in plain language what an agent can do, what it cannot, and how they know.  What We Look For in a Candidate  Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science or a related technical field, or equivalent hands-on experience.  Four or more years of software engineering experience, including at least one year building LLM-based or agent-based applications that reached production users.  Strong Python skills, with C# or TypeScript an advantage, and fluency with asynchronous APIs, REST and GraphQL, JSON schemas and Git-based workflows.  Hands-on experience with Client AI services, including Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, and at least one of Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel or the Client Agent Framework.  Practical retrieval-augmented generation experience covering chunking strategy, embeddings, vector search, reranking and retrieval evaluation.  Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol or comparable tool-calling and function-calling patterns, including schema design and versioning.  Demonstrated skill in prompt and context engineering, including system prompts, few-shot design and model-specific behavior.  Experience evaluating LLM systems with offline and online methods, regression suites and human review loops, and a clear point of view on what is worth measuring.  Familiarity with Client Entra ID, OAuth2 and JWT, role-based access control and API gateway patterns.  Experience with CI/CD, containers, infrastructure as code and observability tooling such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights and OpenTelemetry.  Clear written communication, including the ability to explain agent behavior, limits and failure modes to partners who are not engineers.  Sound judgment about where an agent is the right answer, and the willingness to say plainly when it is not.  Also valuable  Client certification such as Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102) or an Azure architecture credential.  Experience with Power Platform, including Power Automate and Dataverse, or with Client Fabric and Power BI.  Telecommunications, order management, billing or business-to-business commerce domain experience.  Contributions to agent platform tooling, registries, evaluation frameworks or internal developer experience.

lost.source: Position Overview   We are seeking passionate and seasoned professionals to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will help design, develop, and scale AI-enabling platform services and public APIs that are secure, reliable, and cloud-native. These services will act as foundational building blocks for AI adoption across our product portfolio and partner ecosystem.   You will be part of a Scrum team to build innovative, standards-compliant, secure, and production-grade AI capabilities, with a builder mindset, rapid prototyping, and continuous improvement with the agility of a start-up.   Key Responsibilities     Collaborate with multiple teams to create AI solutions, including AI model deployment, training, and AI tooling development.   Build scalable, fault-tolerant cloud-native services on Azure, ensuring high performance and reliability.   Develop secure, well-documented public APIs and SDKs for consumption by internal and external developers.   Work with cross-functional teams to deliver end-to-end solutions across data pipelines, orchestration, and service APIs.   Embed robust security controls to protect sensitive data and ensure secure access to AI services.     Essential Requirements     Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs) and understanding trade-offs between performance, cost, and capability.   Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agent orchestration, prompt engineering, and tool calling.   Familiarity with AI standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent2Agent (A2A).   Proficiency in developing code using AI Tools such as GitHub Copilot and prompt engineering.   Experience in Python and AI frameworks/tools such as PyTorch and TensorFlow.   Experience with tools for automated testing and evaluation of AI outputs.   Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex technical challenges and propose scalable solutions.     Desired Skills and Competencies     Extensive experience in software engineering, preferably in platform or cloud-native service development using C# and .NET technologies.   Strong expertise in RESTful API design, versioning, testing, and lifecycle management.   Strong knowledge or experience in working with various ML algorithms (regression, classification, clustering, deep learning).   Proficient in securing APIs, managing authentication/authorization, and data privacy practices.   Hands-on experience with Azure and associated PaaS services; experience with other cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) is also valued.   Knowledge of AI ethics and regulations and commitment to responsible AI development.   Experience working in Agile teams and collaborating across global R&D locations.     Research & Development   Our global team of developers works on a diverse portfolio of industrial automation and engineering products. AI and cloud are at the center of our strategy, and we have a strong track record of innovation. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.   Benefits   Enjoy flexible work hours, generous PTO, paid volunteering days, parental leave, well-being support, medical, dental, vision, and 401K. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are comprehensive.   Working Arrangement   We work in a hybrid way, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection.

This role will work closely with IT, Manufacturing Engineering, and Operations to develop solutions that improve production efficiency, system reliability, traceability, and data visibility across manufacturing operations.  The ideal candidate will have experience with Microsoft development technologies, database-driven applications, application troubleshooting, and software modernization efforts.     Required Education     Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience.   Required Experience   Minimum 3 years of software development experience.   Experience with .NET Framework and/or .NET Core development.   Experience developing and supporting enterprise applications.       Responsibilities     Develop, test, debug, and maintain software applications, components, tools, and utilities.   Modify software to fix defects, improve performance, and enhance functionality.   Analyze business and manufacturing requirements and develop technical solutions.   Participate in system testing, validation, troubleshooting, and deployment activities.   Work with customers and departments on software design, support, and maintenance.   Consult with stakeholders on project status, technical solutions, and system improvements.   Analyze and recommend enhancements to existing systems or implementation of new solutions. lost.source: Overview   Client is seeking a Healthcare Operations Data Analyst to support the operational and analytical foundation of its pharmacy dispensing and fulfillment operations. This role will develop, automate, validate, and maintain operational metrics and reporting across dispensing data sources while ensuring compliance with HIPAA, protected health information requirements, and covered-entity data-governance policies.   Core Responsibilities     Recreate, validate, maintain, and improve operational metrics using platform usage and pharmacy fulfillment data.   Improve the automation, accuracy, availability, and quality of dispensing and operational data.   Create and deploy operational dashboards for use within the covered entity.   Track and report performance metrics and provide timely, accurate updates to reporting tools.   Develop consolidated reporting views across dispensing data sources to support filtering, grouping, and finance reporting.   Conduct operational performance analysis using SQL and Excel.   Identify trends, operational issues, and improvement opportunities within pharmacy dispensing and fulfillment data.   Translate data findings into clear, actionable insights for internal stakeholders.   Support urgent operational issues through data-driven analysis and cross-functional problem-solving.   Contribute to KPI definitions, reporting standards, and data-strategy documentation.   Handle PHI and other sensitive data according to HIPAA, covered-entity policies, and established data-governance requirements.   Maintain appropriate separation between manufacturer and covered-entity data, including partner-level and patient-level information.     Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies     Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, healthcare administration, data science, or a related discipline.   Proficiency in SQL and Excel.   Proficiency in at least one statistical programming language: Python or R.   Familiarity with healthcare, pharmacy, claims, or dispensing operational data.   1–3 years of work experience within a HIPAA covered entity.   Experience developing, validating, or maintaining operational metrics and reporting.   Understanding of HIPAA, PHI handling, data privacy, and covered-entity compliance requirements.   Ability to complete and maintain required data privacy, HIPAA, and covered-entity compliance training.   Ability to handle protected health information according to established policies.     Preferred Skills or Experience     Experience creating operational dashboards, KPI reporting, or cross-source analytical views.   Experience improving reporting automation, data accuracy, or data-quality validation.   Understanding of pharmacy dispensing and fulfillment operations.   Experience documenting KPIs, reporting processes, or data strategies.   Understanding of manufacturer and covered-entity data-separation requirements.   Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and business acumen.   Ability to communicate complex analytical findings clearly to internal stakeholders.   Experience working across business, operations, analytics, and compliance teams. lost.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.       Job Title:  Software Dev Engineer I   Location(s):  Sunnyvale, CA       Job Description:  The Agentic AI and Applied Foundation Model team is looking for a Software Development Engineer to improve the reliability, maintainability, and testability of complex robotic systems. You will build tools and infrastructure that help engineers diagnose failures, automate operational workflows, reproduce software environments, and understand exactly which software, models, firmware, configurations, and assets were used in each robot test.   This role sits at the intersection of robotics, developer infrastructure, automation, and machine learning systems. You will work with hardware, firmware, simulation, and applied ML teams to turn fragmented operational knowledge and manual processes into dependable software systems.   The ideal candidate is comfortable working across system boundaries, investigating ambiguous failures, and delivering practical tools that make other engineers more effective.   Key Responsibilities:     Develop tools for diagnosing, maintaining, and upgrading robotic systems.   Convert operational knowledge—such as troubleshooting sessions, runbooks, logs, and incident history—into structured, searchable, and context-aware support systems.   Build automation for operational workflows, including issue triage, ownership resolution, notifications, approvals, remediation, and escalation.   Design systems that safely automate actions on production or lab infrastructure while maintaining appropriate human review and auditability.   Build and maintain a registry of robots, test runs, software artifacts, machine-learning models, firmware versions, calibration data, configurations, and simulation assets.   Establish traceability between test inputs and results so experiments can be reproduced, compared, and audited.   Identify configuration and asset drift across development, simulation, and physical systems.   Create automated verification and regression-testing workflows for robotics software and infrastructure changes.   Reproduce robot software stacks in development or lab environments to support debugging, migration, and system-level testing.   Assist with separating software workloads from robot hardware and validating changes across different compute environments.   Support the testing and performance evaluation of optimized machine-learning inference paths.   Improve system observability through logging, metrics, dashboards, alerts, and diagnostic tooling.   Participate in design reviews, incident response, operational support, and continuous improvement of engineering processes.   Produce clear documentation and share technical knowledge across teams.     Basic Qualifications:     Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.   Software development experience using Python and C++.   Knowledge of object-oriented programming.   Experience designing, implementing, testing, and operating production-quality software.   Experience with Linux systems, command-line tooling, networking fundamentals, and debugging distributed or multi-component systems.   Experience building automation, internal developer tools, backend services, or systems integrations.   Familiarity with APIs, structured data, databases, and event-driven or workflow-based systems.   Ability to investigate ambiguous technical problems and turn manual processes into maintainable software solutions.   Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to collaborate across hardware and software disciplines.     Preferred Qualifications:     Experience with robotics, autonomous systems, embedded systems, or hardware-in-the-loop development.   Experience with CI/CD, test infrastructure, artifact management, configuration management, or experiment-tracking systems.   Familiarity with cloud storage and compute services, containers, and infrastructure-as-code.   Experience with machine-learning model deployment, inference runtimes, GPU acceleration, or performance benchmarking.   Familiarity with simulation environments, digital assets, calibration workflows, or robot fleet management.   Experience building retrieval, search, or AI-assisted knowledge systems using documentation, runbooks, logs, and other operational data.   Experience developing safe automation for production systems, including approval workflows, access controls, audit trails, and rollback mechanisms.   Understanding of software and data provenance, reproducibility, versioning, and dependency management.   Experience improving observability and responding to operational incidents.       Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

Understanding of software and data provenance, reproducibility, versioning, and dependency management.   Experience improving observability and responding to operational incidents. lost.source: Job Summary   The Actuarial Software Engineer II is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining actuarial calculation software within modern, scalable .NET-based systems. This role experiments with and develops POCs/MVPs with large language models (LLMs), small language models (SLMs), retrievalaugmented generation (RAG), and agentic AI patterns.     Key Responsibilities:     GenAI POC and MVP Development     Design and implement GenAIpowered automations using LLMs/SLMs, tools, and agents. Prompt Engineering & Feature Engineering (Data)     Design and test prompt templates for data.   Implement data feature engineering for GenAI.       Agentic Architecture & Tool Integration     Design and prototype/develop agentic automations that decompose tasks, plan and reason oversteps, invoke tools and APIs, and handle errors and retries.   Integrate agents with AI platform and other source APIs.   Apply guardrails to control agent autonomy, cost, and risk. Strong understanding of APIfirst and eventdriven architectures.   Experience integrating AI services with enterprise systems and SaaS platforms.       Conceptual & System Skills     Deep understanding of GenAI inference vs traditional deterministic systems, promptcentric and contextcentric design, and agent autonomy vs control tradeoffs.   Ability to translate experimentation into reliable, automated AI systems.   Strong collaboration skills across engineering, product, data, and governance teams.         Preferred Qualifications:     Experience building and maintaining GenAI systems in enterprise or regulated environments.   Familiarity with:     Vector databases and document retrieval systems.          Proven ability to navigate and engineer solutions within complex, multi-application environments and distributed systems.    ·          Exceptional knowledge transfer skills, with a track lost.source: Our client is currently seeking a Data Analyst / Business Systems Analyst  			    Job Title: Data Analyst / Business Systems Analyst - Liquidity Regulatory Reporting    Location:  Westlake, TX (Backup: Omaha, NE)- Hybrid (on-site 4 days per week)    Duration: 12+ Months         About the job    The Liquidity Regulatory Reporting      team within Treasury manages and monitors key regulatory liquidity metrics      and ensures compliance with applicable requirements. This includes the      Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) and related public disclosures, the Net Stable      Funding Ratio (NSFR), and the FR 2052a Complex Institution Liquidity      Monitoring Report. The team also develops tools to help our business      partners analyze the impact of business decisions. In addition, we      collaborate with internal and external partners on ongoing examinations      and audits of liquidity practices. As a Regulatory Reporting Analyst,      you will support the daily production, validation, control, and submission      processes for U.S. liquidity regulatory reporting. You will take primary      responsibility for FR 2052a reporting while providing additional support      for the LCR and NSFR reporting processes. This role requires strong      analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to independently      manage daily production activities within strict regulatory deadlines      while partnering cross-functionally with Treasury, Finance, Risk, Data,      and Technology teams.         Responsibilities    Execute daily FR 2052a production, validation, and      regulatory submission activities in accordance with established procedures      and strict reporting deadlines. Perform detailed variance analysis, reconciliations,      and quality reviews to ensure reporting completeness, accuracy, and      compliance. Utilize SQL to analyze large datasets, investigate      reporting anomalies, and identify root causes of data issues. Monitor reporting processes, data feeds, and system      interfaces; promptly identify, escalate, and track issues to ensure timely      and effective resolution. Support LCR and NSFR reporting processes, including      data validation, reconciliations, and reporting controls. Partner with Treasury, Finance, Risk, Data Management,      and Technology teams to resolve data discrepancies and implement reporting      enhancements. Maintain and enhance reporting procedures, control      documentation, governance evidence, and audit support materials. Participate in testing, implementation, and production      validation of regulatory reporting changes, system upgrades, and new      initiatives. Identify and implement automation opportunities to      improve reporting efficiency, reduce manual processes, and strengthen      operational controls. Develop comprehensive business requirements for      functional and nonfunctional enhancements supporting liquidity regulatory      reporting processes. Create and optimize SQL queries to analyze datasets of      varying complexity, develop analytical models, and interpret data from      multiple sources (databases, spreadsheets, and reporting systems).         Minimum Qualifications    Bachelor's degree. 2-5 years of related experience within a financial      institution (e.g., banking or broker-dealer businesses). Experience with liquidity regulatory reporting,      specifically FR 2052a, Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR), and Net Stable      Funding Ratio (NSFR). Experience working with SQL and Microsoft Excel to      analyze large datasets and run complex queries. Basic knowledge of finance and accounting principles.         Preferred Qualifications    Experience with AxiomSL ControllerView. Knowledge of U.S. GAAP and accounting policy. Hands-on experience implementing automation tools to      optimize reporting processes. Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with a      proven track record in data analysis and trend identification. Excellent documentation skills, with the ability to      create comprehensive business requirements, process documentation, and      analytical reports. Ability to navigate ambiguity, make informed decisions,      and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with changing priorities.    Medical, dental, and vision insurance are available to qualified candidates who meet eligibility requirements.

Job Overview   We are seeking a contractor Graphics Software Engineer to support development of real-time Gaussian Splatting–based rendering systems for avatar and XR applications running on-device (edge devices such as Android phones and AR glasses).  This role focuses on GPU optimization, memory-efficient data pipelines, and real-time Gaussian Splatting rendering under mobile constraints. The ideal candidate will be highly hands-on and able to quickly improve performance-critical systems deployed directly on hardware.   Key Responsibilities   1. Gaussian Splatting Rendering    Develop and optimize Dynamic Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) rendering pipelines       Improve performance of splat-based rendering, including sorting, data layout, and shader efficiency       Analyze and resolve issues such as:       Splat flickering and popping       Sorting inconsistencies       Precision differences between CPU and GPU    2. On-Device GPU Optimization (Android / Edge Devices)    Optimize Gaussian Splatting pipelines for mobile GPUs (e.g., Adreno) on Android       Ensure efficient execution under limited memory, bandwidth, and power constraints       Tune rendering for real-time performance on phones and AR glasses    3. Data Pipeline & Memory Efficiency    Design compact data representations for Gaussian Splatting frame data       Optimize CPU → GPU data transfers for real-time rendering       Eliminate intermediate processing and reduce runtime memory overhead    4. Shader Development & Rendering Pipeline Integration    Implement GPU shaders tailored to Gaussian Splatting data formats       Optimize shader input pathways for efficient on-device execution       Integrate rendering pipelines with motion, lighting systems.    5. Debugging & System Validation    Debug complex rendering issues in Gaussian Splatting pipelines       Investigate numerical precision issues and GPU/CPU inconsistencies       Validate rendering output against reference pipelines    6. Collaboration & Execution    Collaborate closely with XR, vision, and avatar teams       Contribute to on-device demos and prototype systems (phones / AR glasses)       Execute quickly on well-defined tasks with strong ownership of implementation      Required Qualifications      Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field       Strong programming skills in C/C++       Experience with Android platform development       Experience with GPU programming (OpenGL ES, Vulkan, or similar)       Solid understanding of:       Real-time rendering pipelines       GPU memory management       Performance optimization on embedded systems      Preferred Qualifications      Direct experience with Gaussian Splatting / Relighting / Simulation       Experience building graphics systems on mobile or XR devices       Familiarity with Adreno GPU architecture       Experience optimizing for real-time constraints (latency, bandwidth, power)       Experience debugging rendering artifacts in GPU pipelines

Primary Organization Responsibilities  Follows all applicable Monteris Quality System Standard Operating Procedures as well as various applicable FDA, ISO, CSA, and EU regulations and Guidance Documents. Will handle all matters using a high level of judgment, responsibility, and professionalism.  Develops, executes, and maintains automated test scripts and test tools using C#, WPF, and C++ to support software development and verification activities.  Executes manual and automated test protocols and test cases in accordance with approved test plans, requirements, and design specifications.  Builds and maintains automated test cases and test suites using NUnit, Google Test, JUnit, or other equivalent automated test frameworks.  Sets up, configures, and maintains test environments, hardware/software test benches, and laboratory equipment required for verification testing.  Records, documents, and reports test results, defects, and anomalies with clear, accurate, and traceable documentation.  Supports defect identification, logging, tracking, and retesting through resolution and closure.  Assists in the development and revision of test cases, test scripts, and test procedures in response to requirement and design changes.  Maintains traceability between requirements, test cases, and test results within Jama.  Supports automated test execution, monitoring, and reporting through Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.  Collaborates with software engineers, verification analysts, and quality personnel to ensure thorough and accurate test coverage.  Participates in the review of test protocols, test scripts, and test reports.  Supports troubleshooting and root-cause investigation of software defects identified during testing.  Supports testing of image processing and visualization features, including DICOM-based imaging workflows, as applicable to assigned projects.  Participates in the risk planning process as requested or required.  Supports audits, inspections, and regulatory submissions by ensuring test documentation is complete, accurate, and audit ready.  Performs other duties as requested or assigned.     Skills:  Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause investigation skills.  Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), software test methodologies, and software quality assurance principles.  Ability to read and interpret software requirements, design specifications, and test protocols.  Strong attention to detail with a commitment to accurate, thorough, and traceable documentation.  Good organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple test activities and deadlines.  Effective verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to clearly document and report defects and results.  Ability to work collaboratively with software engineers, verification and validation staff, and quality personnel.  Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, regulated development environment.  Willingness to learn new tools, frameworks, and imaging technologies as needed.  Ability to retain information on a confidential basis.     Education/Experience  Associate’s degree or technical certification in software engineering, computer science, engineering technology, or a related field required; Bachelor’s degree preferred.  Minimum of five (5) years of experience in software development and/or software testing.  Application development experience with C# and WPF.  Experience with C++ software development and/or test automation.  Hands-on experience with automated test frameworks such as NUnit, Google Test, JUnit, or comparable frameworks.  Experience executing software verification and validation activities, preferably within a regulated environment.  Experience with VTK/ITK and DICOM image processing and visualization is considered an asset.  Experience with requirements management tools such as Jama and automation orchestration tools such as Jenkins is considered an asset.

Duration :12 Months   Introduction   We are seeking a technically skilled individual to support the development of Genotype x Environment x Management models that provide agronomic insights for internal stakeholders and farmers. This individual will leverage large agricultural datasets from connected equipment (planters, sprayers, combines, etc.), weather data, soil maps, satellite and drone imagery, and other sources to build scalable agronomic decision-support models to improve productivity, profitability, and sustainability in corn, soybean, and cotton production systems. Required Skills & Qualifications     Experience developing, calibrating, validating, and applying APSIM, DSSAT, or comparable process-based crop models for agricultural decision support.   Strong understanding of crop physiology, phenology, soil water dynamics, nutrient cycling, and their influence on crop response to management and environment. Advanced proficiency in R and/or Python for data analysis, simulation workflows, and model development.   Experience working with Databricks, SQL, cloud computing environments, APIs, for scalable analytical and simulation workflows.   Demonstrated experience with AI assisted development.   Experience working with large multi-environment, multi-year, or multi-management agricultural datasets and developing reproducible analytical workflows.   Ability to communicate model assumptions, results, limitations, and uncertainty to both technical and nontechnical audiences.   Experience translating scientific models or research outputs into practical decision-support tools, recommendations, or operational workflows for growers. Plans tests, writes test cases/scripts, automates test cases and executes tests. Defines and tracks quality metrics such as defects and test results. Documents problems and assists in resolution. Delivers quality process training to technical staff and acts as an internal quality consultant to advise or influence business or technical partners. Develops and executes formal plans, procedures and scenarios for manual and automated testing to ensure quality of software applications. Reviews and assesses test coverage to ensure thorough quality review. Plans tests, writes test cases/scripts, automates test cases and executes tests. Perform smoke, application, functional and regression testing, including appropriate level of testing to ensure that systems or applications are tested effectively prior to implementation. Documents and tracks test results, defects and other quality metrics. Enters problems and issues into system and participates in resolution. Develops and implements quality standards and best practices, contributing ideas and effort toward continuous improvement. Delivers quality process training to technical staff and acts as an internal quality consultant to advise or influence business or technical partners. EDUCATION: Bachelors degree or equivalent combination of education and experience required. REQUIRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES: Excellent problem solving abilities. Ability to multi-task, prioritize and meet deadlines. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Drive and initiative. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with team members. Excellent analytical, verbal and written communication skills. PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Extensive sitting, phone and computer use. Some travel may be required. WORK ENVIRONMENT: General office environment. Normal office noise level, with occasional moderate noise.    MUST HAVE:  Strong understanding of JavaScript and TypeScript (like a developer);  Hands-on experience with Cypress and Playwright;  SQL (Select, insert, update, delete & joins);  Extensive experience with SOAP & REST API using HTTP clients and standalone tools;  DICOM technology.    NICE TO HAVE:  AWS (lambdas, notifications, parameter store);  Jenkins;  Github Actions;  Command line.

Location:  Charlotte, NC, Uptown Work Model:  Hybrid, 3 days per week in office Contract Duration:  12 months, with intent to extend up to 24 months Primary Technical Requirement:  SQL Server expertise About the Role We are seeking an experienced  Software/Data Engineer  to join a Capital Markets Investment Banking Technology team in Charlotte, NC. In this role, you will help support the expansion and modernization of front-office technology capabilities, with a particular focus on  risk, capital, and data modernization . You will design and develop scalable solutions within the existing technology ecosystem, helping strengthen the current platform while creating reusable products and services that can be leveraged by other applications. The ideal candidate brings  strong SQL Server expertise , hands-on Python development experience, and a solid background building data-intensive or distributed applications. What You’ll Do Analyze and interpret the organization’s  Data Modernization strategy  across impacted technology and business disciplines. Design, develop, and implement scalable, high-quality data solutions. Partner with business and technology stakeholders to define and formalize business requirements. Translate business requirements into detailed technical requirements and solution designs. Develop applications and data solutions using  SQL Server and Python . Build and support distributed applications, microservices, and RESTful APIs. Develop reusable technology components that can be integrated with other internal applications. Participate in Agile development workstreams and manage development activities through Jira. Collaborate with engineering, risk, capital, and front-office technology teams. Leverage DevOps practices and tools to support automated development, testing, and deployment. Help improve engineering efficiency and increase delivery capacity within the Agile development environment. Minimum Qualifications Strong hands-on expertise with  Microsoft SQL Server , including advanced SQL development and working with relational data. Professional software development or programming experience using  Python . Experience in  data engineering and/or full-stack application development . Experience using Python data-processing frameworks or libraries such as  Pandas, Polars, PyTorch, or similar technologies . Experience designing or developing  distributed applications . Experience working with relational database platforms such as  SQL Server, Oracle, DB2, or similar technologies . Experience designing or working within  microservices architectures . Experience developing and integrating  RESTful APIs . Experience with DevOps and CI/CD tools such as  Git, Jenkins, and automated deployment toolkits . Experience working within an  Agile software development environment . Preferred Qualifications Experience with  Test-Driven Development (TDD) . Experience working within  Capital Markets , particularly investment banking or front-office technology. Familiarity with risk disciplines, including  Market Risk and Counterparty Credit Risk . Knowledge of  derivative products, financial risk management, and financial product data modeling . Experience or familiarity with  Generative AI and Agentic AI technologies . What Will Help You Succeed You’ll be successful in this role if you are comfortable working across both business and technology teams, can translate complex requirements into scalable technical solutions, and enjoy solving data-intensive problems in a fast-paced environment. Because of the role’s focus, candidates should have particularly strong experience with  SQL Server and relational data architectures , complemented by solid Python development skills. Candidates who are open to relocating to Charlotte may also be considered. Work Location Charlotte, North Carolina, Uptown This is a hybrid position requiring employees to work  onsite 3 days per week . It communicates the engineering scope without making the role appear limited to database administration, while the posting itself clearly establishes  SQL Server as the top technical requirement . Benefits Featured    Medical, Dental , and Vision Insurance is offered to qualified candidates.  			  			 Medical, dental, and vision insurance are available to qualified candidates who meet eligibility requirements.
